exposure: Mean maximum and minimum temperature (Tmax, Tmin)
Maximum and minimum average humidity (Umax, Umin)
Maximum and minimum atmospheric pressure mean (P max, P min)
cohort: The study included 189 cases of premature births with a gestational age between 24 to 37 weeks, excluding those with antepartum fetal death and uncertain gestational age.
finding: The study found a moderate positive correlation between weekly preterm birth incidence and average temperature and temperature variation, but no significant correlation with humidity variation, pressure variation, or wind speed.
